Little details that matter

Description of the promotion  

Up to 35,000 reward points upon enrollment, and a refund of the annual fee for the first year for the primary cardholder of a National Bank® Platinum Mastercard®.  

Length of the welcome promotion  

From June 30, 2026, to November 4, 2026. 

Eligibility conditions  

Sign up for a National Bank® Platinum Mastercard® credit card as a primary cardholder during the promotion period.  

Have not held any National Bank personal Mastercard credit card as a primary cardholder during the past 12 months.  

Keep the credit card account open and in good standing, in compliance with the Credit Card Agreement, until the annual fee refund and reward points are credited. For example, all minimum payments must be made on time.   

Must not be employed by National Bank of Canada or an entity in its group. 

Annual fees  

The $70 annual fee for the primary cardholder will be refunded for the first year.   

We will charge the annual fee to your new card account and then refund it. You will receive this refund within five months of opening your account, provided that your account remains open and in good standing. The refund will appear on your statement as a credit.   

Annual fees related to authorized users’ cards are not eligible for this promotion.  

Reward points  

Points offered Conditions When points are awarded
10,000 Enrollment in credit card payment insurance* for at least the first three months Within two months following the minimum enrollment period 
10,000 $2,500 in purchases within the first three months**   By the end of the 6th month following enrollment**
15,000 $10,000 in purchases within the first 12 months** By the end of the 15th month following enrollment**

* To apply for payment insurance, you must complete the sections related to the Credit Card Payment Protection Plan (CCPPP) included in the credit card application form.   

** The purchase calculation period starts on the date you sign up for the card. For example, if you sign up on July 15, 2026, you have until October 15, 2026, to make the required $2,500 in purchases, and the 10,000 points will be credited to your account by the end of January 2027.   

How total purchases are calculated  

The calculation is based on the total amount of purchases made using all cards linked to the account.  

Transactions not included in the calculation are set out in Article 1.5 of the À la carte Rewards Plan™.  

Other conditions  

  • This promotion may only be used once per person.  
  • Issuance of the card is subject to National Bank of Canada’s credit approval. Other conditions apply to the issuance of the card.   
  • Unless otherwise indicated, this promotion cannot be combined with any other National Bank credit card promotion and is not retroactive.   
  • This promotion may be modified or withdrawn without notice.

There are two main elements of a joint credit card:

  • The primary cardholder’s name will be the one that appears on the credit card contract. This person can decide to add up to three authorized users to their account, as well as remove them at any time. They must meet all the eligibility criteria to apply for a credit card. 

  • An authorized user has their own card and PIN. However, all transactions made by that person are charged to the primary cardholder’s account. An authorized user could be a spouse, a child aged 16 or older, or a friend. The designated person doesn’t need to meet all of the eligibility criteria to access their card. 

Please remember that the primary cardholder is responsible for paying any outstanding balances and managing the account. This also means that they’re the ones who will receive any cashback generated by the account. If any disagreements or separations occur, the authorized users and primary cardholder must agree on how to proceed. 

The authorized user doesn’t receive a statement and doesn’t have access to transaction details and account information, including the credit card limit. However, both cardholders can enjoy the benefits of their card. They can also change their respective PINs, as well as cancel or replace their cards.

How do I get a joint credit card?

If you’re applying for a new credit card, answer “Yes” to the “Do you need an additional card” question in our application form.

If you’d like an additional card for an existing account, fill out our credit card application or call us at 1-888-622-2783. 

Please note that there’s an annual fee for an additional credit card. 

To learn about how we protect your information, consult our Confidentiality Policies.

Length of the welcome promotion

From December 2, 2025, to February 2, 2026.

Eligibility conditions

  • Sign up for a National Bank® Platinum Mastercard® credit card during the promotion as a primary cardholder.
  • Have not held a personal National Bank Mastercard credit card as a primary cardholder during the past 24 months.
  • Keep the credit card account open until the rewards points are paid.
  • Keep the account in good standing while complying with the conditions in the Credit Card Agreement, until the rewards points are paid. For example, all minimum payments must be made on time.
  • Not be employed by National Bank or an entity in its group.

Description of the promotion

Up to 25,000 rewards points upon enrollment and the annual fees refunded for the first year for the primary cardholder and the first additional authorized user.

Annual fees

No annual fees for the first year for the primary cardholder and the first additional authorized user.

We will charge annual fees to the account of your new card and reimburse those fees to you. You will receive this reimbursement within five months of opening your account, provided that your account remains open and in good standing. It will appear on your statement in the form of a credit. 

To benefit from the annual fee discount for the first additional authorized user’s card, you must add it to the account opening request.

Annual fees related to other authorized users’ cards are not eligible for this promotion.

Rewards points

Points offered Conditions When points are awarded to the account
10,000 Enrollment in payment insurance* for at least the first three months In the two months following the minimum enrollment period for payment insurance**
5,000 $2,500 in purchases in the first three months** By the end of the 6th month after enrollment.**
10,000 $10,000 in purchases in the first 12 months** By the end of the 15th month after enrollment.**

* To apply for enrollment in payment insurance, you must complete the sections to apply for the Credit Card Payment Protection Plan (CCPPP) included on the credit card application form.

** The purchase calculation period starts on the date you sign up for the card. For example, if you sign up for the card on December 15, you have until February 15 to make the required purchases to receive the points which will be credited to your account by the end of June 2026.

How total purchases are calculated

The calculation is for the total amount of purchases made through all cards linked to the account. The transactions not included in the calculation are set out in article 1.5 of the À la carte Rewards PlanTM.

Other conditions

  • You can only take advantage of the promotion once.
  • Issuance of the card is subject to credit approval by National Bank of Canada. Other conditions apply to the issue of the card.
  • This promotion may not be combined with any other promotion or offer applicable to National Bank credit cards, nor is it retroactive.
  • This promotion may be modified or withdrawn without notice.

You will earn 2 points for every dollar in eligible grocery and restaurant purchases until a total of $1,000 in gross monthly purchases is charged to the account. After that, you will earn 1.5 points per dollar in eligible grocery and restaurant purchases. The total gross monthly amount is calculated based on your monthly billing period. Grocery purchases include any purchase made at a store that primarily sells food, i.e., grocery store, delicatessen, supermarket, greengrocer or specialty food store. Ready-to-eat meal services and meal delivery services are eligible. This definition excludes purchases made at retail stores and big box stores whose core business is the sale of non-food items. Certain merchants may sell products and services that appear identical or similar to those sold by eligible merchants, or may be separate merchants located on the same premises as eligible merchants, but are classified in different categories by Mastercard. For purchases at other merchants, you will only earn regular rewards points. Restaurant purchases include purchases at a restaurant, fast food restaurant, bar, nightclub or pub. For a full list of Mastercard codes associated with eligible merchants, download the terms and conditions of the À la carte Rewards Plan®.

8. To earn 1.5 points per dollar in purchases, you will need to purchase gas or an electrical vehicle charge from a service station or from certain big box stores. For purchases at other merchants, you will only earn regular rewards points. For a full list of Mastercard codes associated with eligible merchants, download the terms and conditions of the À la carte Rewards Plan®.

9. Recurring bill payments are defined as monthly or regular payments automatically charged by a merchant to your National Bank Platinum Mastercard credit card.
